description.text: There are A, B, C three levels of scholarship for you to apply according to your overall evaluation. Click the small picture to view the full-sized picture. How much do I have to pay to get my Scholarship? For the service fee, generally speaking, SICAS will only charge you 10% of the 4 or 3 years of total scholarship amount (there could be a bit difference according to the exact Type of Scholarship that you choose). However, in the beginning , only $300 to $400 need to be paid as a minimum service fee and $75 as application fee to the university at first. When SICAS help you successfully get the scholarship,then the price difference need to be paid. For example: If you get the Undergraduate C Level of Shandong Jiaotong University, The total cost will be: RMB 9000x 4years x 10% =RMB 3600 = USD 600. and since you have paid USD 400, then the price difference: USD 600 - USD 400 = USD 200 need to be paid. Scholarship Guaranteed ? Yes. -After you paid the Scholarship Service Fee as above table listed, SICAS will guarantee you the scholarship! It is true. -Refund or not ? 100% refund if SICAS failed to get the scholarship (Application Fee +Service Fee) for you! Refund Policy Declaration from SICAS board as following sealed and singed. Click the small picture to view the full-sized picture. Objectives The PhD program in Electronic & Information Engineering provides students with solid theory and the latest technological knowledge. Students will have a broad choice on the research topics in telecommunication engineering, signal and system, biomedical engineering, integrated circuits, optical communications, and micro/nano photonics. Students will acquire the latest technical know-how by engaging in specialized subjects in a chosen area that focus on the cutting edge issues. After the program, students are expected to engage in high level scientific research, and assume leadership role in their related fields. Duration Duration of program is between 3-4 years with course works in the first year, followed by a dissertation project. Research Areas 1. Communication and Information Theory 2. Signal Processing 3. Biomedical Engineering 4. Wireless Communications and Networking 5. Solid-state Electronics & Photonics Credit Units Students need to successfully complete minimum 14 credits, among which 10 must be core courses, 3 must be elective courses, and 1 must be academic report. Inquiry to email: scholarship@sicas.cn

duration.text: The Information and Communication Engineering at Harbin Institute of Technology(Shenzhen Campus) is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5833 USD/per year ￥ 42000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6. Study Plan in Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen Campus)

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. 2. Be Healthy. 3. Have attained a Master's diploma with good marks. 4. Have solid financial support to afford the study and living expense in China. 5. Good English reading, writing and speaking skills.
